title: Orchard and Bridge
author: Lior Oyelaran
blurb: Mara Iversen, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
